description: Search for places (points of interest / businesses) in Overture Maps data. Scope every search with a `lat`+`lng` and a `radius` (up to 25 km); geocode a named town or city to coordinates first. A country-wide search (`country` with no lat/lng) is only available on paid plans; `country` can always be added alongside lat/lng as an extra filter. Filter by `categories` (e.g. restaurant, cafe, bakery — use list_place_categories to discover valid values), `brand_name` (e.g. Starbucks), or `has_contact` to only return places with a website/phone. Returns compact summaries (name, category, location, website, phone), not full geometry.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, US, FR. On its own (no lat/lng) this needs a paid plan.

has_contact.description: Only return places that have at least one of these contact fields (OR): website, phone, email, social. e.g. 'website,social'.

lat.description: Latitude for a radius search. Requires lng.

lng.description: Longitude for a radius search. Requires lat.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence 0-1 (default 0.5). Higher = more precise, fewer results.

page.description: 0-indexed page number for paging through results.

radius.description: Search radius in metres for a lat/lng search (default 1000, max 25000).

taxonomy.description: Hierarchy-aware category, e.g. 'food_and_drink' matches every restaurant/cafe/bar/bakery.

name: search_places
